$comment: Exercises as data (POSE-17, docs/pose-optimization-plan.md Phases 3-4), read by engine.ts. Each exercise: 'driver' = the joint angle that goes down and up once per rep (angle at the middle joint, both sides combined); 'params' = thresholds in degrees / metres / ratios (PRD Appendix C), tuned on team clips (docs/evaluation.md); 'checks' = form rules, each naming a rule from engine.ts, the cue code it raises and the params it reads ('below' = only while the driver is under that param); 'gates' = edge-case rules judged at the deepest frame of each attempt, voiding attempts that aren't the exercise ('on': 'rep' voids only full reps); 'visible' = body parts that must be in view (MediaPipe only reports visibility). Push-up keeps its starting values until landscape clips are labelled. 'backends' overrides params per pose model.

lunge.$comment: Driver 'min' = the front leg (the more bent knee). 'bothLegsBend' only voids full reps: in a shallow lunge the back leg can stay nearly straight (EC3D).

backends.$comment: MediaPipe Pose Landmarker reads the knee 8-20 deg straighter and the torso ~10-15 deg more forward than InstantHMR, and its 3D can't see knee cave-in from the side (Phase 0). Squat tuned on 4 team clips (side good/mixed, front good/knees-in). Push-up and lunge are not yet validated on MediaPipe and use the InstantHMR values.
